categories.name: Character classes
categories.description: Character classes describe sets, ranges, properties, and other rules that select a single governed text unit.

categories.name: Approximate, partial, streaming and multi-pattern
categories.description: These features extend matching beyond one complete subject and one exact pattern, covering edits, incomplete input, streams, and pattern databases.

categories.name: Quantification and match selection
categories.description: Quantification controls repetition, while selection rules decide which viable start, length, and alternative become the reported match.

categories.name: Unicode and text model
categories.description: Text-model features define the units, encodings, properties, normalization, case behavior, and segmentation rules visible to matching.

categories.name: Diagnostics, resources and safety
categories.description: These features govern errors, limits, termination, memory and time behavior, and the observable safety contracts of compilation and matching.

categories.name: Anchors and boundaries
categories.description: Anchors and boundaries test positions in a subject or search region without consuming the surrounding text.

categories.name: Backreferences, recursion and conditionals
categories.description: These constructs reuse captured text or subpatterns and choose behavior from capture, assertion, or recursive state.

categories.name: Backtracking control and embedded code
categories.description: Control features change the matcher’s search path, commit or reject alternatives, or invoke host-visible code and callouts.

categories.name: Groups and captures
categories.description: Groups organize subpatterns and captures expose matched spans, names, histories, and other result state to later constructs or host operations.

categories.name: Replacement language
categories.description: Replacement features define how matched text and captures are expanded, transformed, or supplied to callbacks after a match.

categories.name: Lookaround assertions
categories.description: Lookaround tests whether a subpattern does or does not match before or after the current position without consuming it as part of the result.

categories.name: Lookaround extensions
categories.description: These assertions test captured text or permit non-atomic lookbehind behavior under source-specific matching rules.

categories.name: Options and state
categories.description: These features govern inline and scoped modifier state within a pattern.

categories.name: Grammar and composition
categories.description: Grammar and composition features define literals, concatenation, alternatives, comments, quoting, and the structural rules for forming patterns.

categories.name: Host-operation and result semantics
categories.description: These features describe how host APIs search, iterate, split, extract, position, and advance through results around the regex itself.

categories.name: Editor, CLI and product surfaces
categories.description: Product-surface features capture observable regex behavior supplied by editors, command-line tools, databases, and other host environments.
